system.description: Throwing a net over someone is a good way to restrain him for a short time, and in mortal combat, a short time is all an attacker needs. Nets restrain the target's entire body, but loosely. The target can still try to fight, but he must use a flurry and he suffers penalties for the restraint. Some nets are specially made with hooks or barbs to injure targets as they struggle to free themselves. A hooked net inflicts no more than 1L per action.
